interpretation.fixtures: Equal companion levels, craft +6, legal base talents4/6/8/10 at25/40/50/60, no artifacts or forced recovery. Not the user save.
interpretation.paired: Same initial seed and fixture; after the first fight, native PRNG/rewards/XP carry may produce different encounters. Do not treat consecutive fights as identical enemy replay.
interpretation.combined: After includes the authorized reaction, healing, boss and shield source changes. Only-shield pilot is separately preserved.
interpretation.damage: Actual HP damage sums native per-packet before/after HP, excluding logged overkill. ShieldStrengthConsumed sums shieldBefore-shieldAfter pool loss, not prevented HP. The old sequential ally log.absorbed counted shield units; corrected simultaneous ally log.absorbed is blocked HP. Do not compare those raw log sums as the same unit.
interpretation.recovery: No lodging action is taken; lodgingMora=0 is not a claim that the party needs no recovery. Victory may revive the protagonist at10% HP, and native level-up may fully recover living fighters. Pre-settlement HP/deaths, levelUpOwners and revival are retained; a post-settlement100% party is not proof of a healer sustaining full HP.
interpretation.statistics: Selected deterministic seeds are diagnostic examples, not population win-rate estimates. Do not pool different regions/rosters/constellations into a rarity conclusion.
